summary: Fewer false alarms: one missed report to Invardia no longer looks like a problem.

new.title: The Invardia support link has its own name
new.text: The job that sends health and run results to Invardia support is now called the Invardia support link on Jobs & schedule, the overview and Settings. It does not connect to another tenant.

new.title: No alarm for one missed report
new.text: A report that could not be delivered is retried next cycle and the run stays green. Only three misses in a row turn it amber, and you are never mailed about it.
